probable_root_causes.cause: Insufficient Training or Experience with New Commercial Spacecraft
Inadequate Risk Assessment and Mitigation for Novel Launch Vehicle Operations

contributing_factors.factor: Rapid Development and Deployment of New Commercial Capabilities
Increased Complexity in Spacecraft Design and Operations

recommended_actions.action: Enhance Training and Certification for Commercial Spacecraft Operators
Conduct Thorough Risk Assessments and Implement Mitigation Strategies for Novel Launch Vehicle Operations

probable_root_causes.cause: Human error during spacecraft assembly
Inadequate quality control of critical components

contributing_factors.factor: Rushed development timeline
Insufficient training for ground personnel

recommended_actions.action: Implement additional quality control measures during spacecraft assembly
Provide comprehensive training programs for ground personnel

probable_root_causes.cause: Improperly configured navigation system
Inadequate training for crew on emergency procedures

contributing_factors.factor: High-stress environment during mission
Limited resources and personnel available for mission support

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough review of navigation system configuration procedures
Develop and implement comprehensive training program for crew on emergency procedures

probable_root_causes.cause: Failure of the back-up Inertial Reference System
Failure of the active Inertial Reference System

contributing_factors.factor: Nominal behaviour up to H0 + 36 seconds

recommended_actions.action: Investigate and replace or repair the Inertial Reference Systems
Review and improve the flight control system redundancy

probable_root_causes.cause: Insufficient testing of proximity operations phase
Inadequate monitoring and response to navigation system anomalies

contributing_factors.factor: Unforeseen interaction between DART's propulsion system and MUBLCOM
Lack of redundancy in DART's navigation system

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough testing and validation of proximity operations phase for future autonomous rendezvous missions
Implement real-time monitoring and response procedures for navigation system anomalies

probable_root_causes.cause: Premature parachute deployment
Incorrect atmospheric density estimation

contributing_factors.factor: Insufficient testing of the landing system
Inadequate communication between teams

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough review of parachute deployment mechanisms and atmospheric density estimation algorithms
Implement additional testing protocols for the landing system

probable_root_causes.cause: Improper deployment of drogue parachute

contributing_factors.factor: Inadequate testing and validation of pyrotechnic systems
Insufficient communication between JPL and NASA teams during the mission

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough review of pyrotechnic systems and testing procedures
Improve communication protocols between JPL and NASA teams during missions

probable_root_causes.cause: Improperly configured navigation system
Inadequate quality control during spacecraft assembly

contributing_factors.factor: Unusual atmospheric conditions at launch time
Insufficient training for mission control team

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough review of navigation system configuration and testing procedures
Implement additional quality control measures during spacecraft assembly

probable_root_causes.cause: Communication anomaly

contributing_factors.factor: Satellite design and testing process
International collaboration and coordination

recommended_actions.action: Review and improve communication protocols
Conduct thorough design and testing process review

probable_root_causes.cause: Insufficient testing and validation of navigation systems

contributing_factors.factor: Inadequate communication between teams responsible for spacecraft design and mission planning
Lack of redundancy in critical systems, such as navigation and propulsion

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough testing and validation of all spacecraft systems before launch
Improve communication and collaboration between teams responsible for spacecraft design, mission planning, and operations

probable_root_causes.cause: Inadequate preparation and verification of the Turn-Over Cart (TOC) adapter plate before the satellite repositioning operation

contributing_factors.factor: Insufficient training or experience with the TOC system among the personnel involved in the operation
Rushed or inadequate planning and scheduling of the satellite repositioning operation

recommended_actions.action: Implement additional checks and verifications before performing critical operations involving the TOC system
Provide comprehensive training and familiarization with the TOC system to all personnel involved in satellite repositioning operations

probable_root_causes.cause: Failure of the payload fairing separation mechanism

contributing_factors.factor: Insufficient testing or validation of the payload fairing separation mechanism
Inadequate design or manufacturing of the payload fairing

recommended_actions.action: Conduct a thorough investigation and testing of the payload fairing separation mechanism to identify the root cause of the failure
Review and improve the design and manufacturing process for the payload fairing to prevent similar failures in the future

probable_root_causes.cause: Ground errors led to loss of attitude

contributing_factors.factor: Failure to adequately monitor spacecraft status
Erroneous decision disabling part of on-board autonomous failure detection

recommended_actions.action: Comprehensive review of SOHO operations addressing issues in ground procedures, procedure implementation, management structure and process, and ground systems

probable_root_causes.cause: Insufficient testing or simulation of critical systems
Human error or miscommunication during mission planning and execution

contributing_factors.factor: Inadequate risk assessment and mitigation strategies
Insufficient training or experience of personnel involved in the mission

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough testing and simulation of critical systems before launch
Implement additional training and experience requirements for personnel involved in the mission

probable_root_causes.cause: Insufficient testing and validation of the spacecraft's propulsion system

contributing_factors.factor: Inadequate communication and coordination between teams involved in the mission planning and execution
Lack of clear procedures for handling unexpected propulsion system anomalies

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough testing and validation of the spacecraft's propulsion system before future missions
Establish clear procedures for handling unexpected propulsion system anomalies and conduct regular training exercises to ensure crew preparedness

probable_root_causes.cause: Insufficient thermal protection system inspection and maintenance

contributing_factors.factor: Rushed re-entry procedure due to changing weather conditions
Inadequate communication between mission control and crew

recommended_actions.action: Implement a more thorough thermal protection system inspection and maintenance schedule
Develop and implement standardized communication protocols for mission control and crew

probable_root_causes.cause: Insufficient testing and validation of new design features
Inadequate training for crew members on new systems

contributing_factors.factor: Rushed development schedule to meet tight deadlines
Lack of clear communication and coordination among team members

recommended_actions.action: Conduct thorough testing and validation of new design features before implementation
Provide comprehensive training for crew members on new systems

probable_root_causes.cause: Thermo-structural failure in the forward dome area of the Z23 motor

contributing_factors.factor: Insufficient testing or verification of the Z23 motor's thermal and structural integrity
Inadequate maintenance or inspection procedures for the Vega launch vehicle

recommended_actions.action: Conduct a thorough review and verification of the Z23 motor's design, testing, and maintenance procedures
Implement additional safety measures to prevent similar thermo-structural failures in the future

probable_root_causes.cause: Digital logic design error in the instrument pyro electronics box

contributing_factors.factor: Transient performance of components not adequately considered in the box design
Startup characteristics of Vectron crystal clock oscillator and Actel A1020 FPGA not considered

recommended_actions.action: Review and revise digital logic design for instrument pyro electronics box to account for transient performance of components
Consider startup characteristics of all critical components in future designs
